name: 31181-hicacheprefix-qwen3next80b-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Thinking, bf16, unquantized. Not substitutable, and not gated.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One node.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 10%, 600 requests, safety cap 2400 s, seed 31181.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn: one of ten distinct 6400-token system prompts followed by a unique 3600-token question, generating exactly 500 tokens. Prompt and output lengths are fixed.
purpose: An 80-billion-parameter reasoning assistant answering 10,000-token questions under ten shared system prompts, 32 concurrent users, four GPUs.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang at commit 1054060ef1192bceab0e844b8a51fd083cab1b39, `sglang serve` CLI form.
#
# FLAT PARSER: one `key: value` per line. A nested block is DROPPED silently, which would run
# the engine without something this file claims to declare.
#
# `attention-backend` below is the FULL-attention knob only; the linear-attention layers are on
# a separate argument, which is left at its default and should stay there.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Thinking

tp-size: 4

enable-hierarchical-cache: true
hicache-ratio: 12
hicache-write-policy: write_through
hicache-io-backend: direct
hicache-mem-layout: page_first_direct
mamba-radix-cache-strategy: extra_buffer

max-total-tokens: 131072
max-running-requests: 32
chunked-prefill-size: 16384
max-prefill-tokens: 32768
page-size: 64
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

attention-backend: triton

random-seed: 31181
